<ic>Vittorio von Holberg requests access to the Imperial Archives for the purpose of collating historical maps from the various ages of the Empire and before, with a view to pinpointing sites of interest, such as the location of battlefields, regios and the deeds of paragons. This request would be entirely self-funded.<br><br>
Proposed by Volodmartz, seconded by Kahraman</ic>

===Overview===
* [[Historical research]]
* Passed unanimously

===Date===
* Passed Spring 377YE (Event Two 2013).

===Cost===
* 5 Thrones.

===Progress===
* Complete

===Campaign Outcome===
* Maps were handed over to relevant parties.
